findings.title: China-Linked JDY Botnet Expands to 1,500+ Devices for Cyber Reconnaissance
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News reported on June 10, 2026 that the JDY botnet grew from 650 to over 1,500 devices following the KV-botnet takedown. The article links the network to Volt Typhoon and notes rapid reconnaissance and vulnerability targeting, including CVE-2026-35616.

findings.title: KV-botnet: Don't call it a comeback - Lumen Technologies
findings.summary_md: Lumen's Black Lotus Labs published findings on February 7, 2024 documenting KV-botnet, a China-linked SOHO router botnet used for covert data transfer. The report establishes the precursor infrastructure that later evolved into the expanded JDY network.

findings.title: Fortinet FortiGuard Advisory FG-IR-26-099 for CVE-2026-35616
findings.summary_md: Fortinet's advisory dated April 4, 2026 confirms CVE-2026-35616, an improper access control vulnerability in FortiClient EMS versions 7.4.5 through 7.4.6. The flaw allows unauthenticated remote code execution and is actively exploited, matching the vulnerability the JDY operators targeted.
